title: Carrier relaxation confines the Bogdanov--Takens degeneracy of an optically injected semiconductor laser
abstract: Optically injected semiconductor lasers are forced nonlinear oscillators whose locking boundaries are organized by codimension-two points. We ask which property of the carrier balance permits or forbids a Bogdanov--Takens (BT) point in the standard three-dimensional rate equations. Taking the carrier inversion $n$ as distinguished observable, the rate that enters the spectral conditions is the slope of the gain--loss balance, $\xi=\partial\dot n/\partial n=-2\Gamma/\kappa$, where $\Gamma$ is the damping of the relaxation oscillation and $\kappa=1+2Bn$ the normalized stimulated-emission factor. The two BT conditions become affine in $\xi$ and imply the exact sum rule $K^{2}=I[1-(1+\kappa)I]$ between injection amplitude $K$ and intracavity intensity $I$. The product of the two relaxation eigenvalues that survive at a saddle-node is bounded below by $1-16\Gamma^{2}$, so that no BT point exists for $\Gamma<1/4$, whatever $B$, the linewidth enhancement factor, the injection strength and the detuning; below this barrier every contact between Hopf and saddle-node curves is a fold--Hopf point. For $B=0$ the barrier is completed to an exact existence criterion. We prove that the unfolding of a BT point by injection strength and detuning is transversal if and only if two explicit curves cross transversally in the plane of locked states; for $B=0$ this is a simple root of an explicit function, and transversality fails exactly at the existence threshold. Two BT points at $\Gamma=1/2$, $\alpha=2$ are verified to be generic, and the contacts between Hopf and saddle-node curves are classified into fold--Hopf, BT and nilpotent triple-zero points.

summaries.en: The paper shows that in optically injected semiconductor lasers modeled by standard three-dimensional rate equations, the possibility of a Bogdanov–Takens point depends on carrier relaxation through the gain–loss balance slope and yields an exact sum rule between injection amplitude and intracavity intensity, with BT points impossible for relaxation-oscillation damping Γ<1/4 and fully characterized unfolding and genericity via transversality conditions and explicit criteria.
summaries.zh: 本文在标准三维速率方程模型下证明，光注入半导体激光器的Bogdanov–Takens（BT）点是否存在由载流子弛豫通过增益-损耗平衡斜率所决定，并得到注入幅度与腔内强度之间的精确和规则；同时说明当弛豫振荡阻尼Γ<1/4时无BT点存在，且通过显式的反交叉（横向性）条件给出BT点展开的刻画、验证特定参数下BT点的普适性，并对Hopf与鞍结曲线的接触类型进行分类（包括折叠-霍普、BT和零阶三重零点）。

title: Transport Layer-Driven Optimization of Color and Efficiency in TADF OLEDs for Large-Area Applications
abstract: Balancing structural simplicity with high efficiency is crucial for practical applications of organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs), especially in large-area lighting devices. Optimizing the charge-transport layers in multilayer OLEDs controls the recombination zone within the emissive layer, thereby enhancing the device's performance. Herein, we experimentally and computationally investigate how the thicknesses of the electron and hole transport layers affect the performance of orange-red thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF) OLEDs. Using a TADF emitter, 2-[4-(diphenylamino)phenyl]-10,10-dioxide-9H-thioxanthen-9-one (TXO-TPA), at 10 wt\% concentration in 4,4-Bis(N-carbazolyl)-1,1-biphenyl (CBP) host, we achieve a maximum external quantum efficiency ($\eta_{EQE}$) of 20.86\% and a peak luminance of 32,800 cd m$^{-2}$. Using a combination of drift-diffusion and optical simulations, we reveal how variations in hole- and electron-transport-layer thicknesses modulate the charge-carrier balance and shift the recombination zone within the emissive layer. This tuning not only optimizes exciton formation but also enables color tuning from green to red without altering the emissive material. Our findings highlight the critical role of transport layer engineering in achieving efficient, color-controlled OLEDs with simplified architectures. Furthermore, we successfully demonstrate a large-area OLED device (~20 cm$^{2}$), achieving an impressive $\eta_{EQE}$ of 17\%, underscoring the scalability and practicality of our approach for general lighting applications.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally and computationally shows that engineering the thicknesses of electron and hole transport layers in orange-red TADF OLEDs can tune the charge recombination zone, improving exciton formation, enabling green-to-red color tuning without changing the emitter, and scaling to a ~20 cm² device with 17% external quantum efficiency.
summaries.zh: 论文通过实验与计算表明，在橙红色TADF OLED中调控电子与空穴传输层的厚度可调节电荷复合区位置，从而提升激子形成效率、在不更换发光材料的情况下实现从绿色到红色的颜色调控，并将该策略扩展到约20 cm²器件，外量子效率达到17%。

title: Ferroionic CuCrP2S6 Integrated Silicon Photonics for Neuromorphic Computing
abstract: Neuromorphic photonic computing calls for optical states that combine stimulus accumulation, spontaneous relaxation, and nonvolatile state retention without continuous power dissipation. Here, we demonstrate a ferroionic photonic platform by integrating layered van der Waals CuCrP2S6 onto silicon microring resonators using a back-end integration process. Electrical pulsing produces unidirectional blue shifts in the optical resonance, consistent with field-driven redistribution of mobile Cu ions and giving rise to a history-dependent optical response. The resulting optical state is strongly pulse dependent, exhibiting both volatile and nonvolatile components. A short 20-pulse excitation produces an initial 70 pm resonance shift that relaxes toward baseline within approximately 60 s, with a volatile relaxation time constant of 27-29 s. In contrast, after 1000 pulses, an initial 0.27 nm resonance shift relaxes to a persistent 0.13 nm nonvolatile state that is retained for at least 24 h. Repeated 6 V electrical pulses produce a progressive resonance shift over 1000 cycles, demonstrating cumulative optical integration. A fixed-wavelength readout converts the accumulated resonance shift into a thresholded optical response, with the normalized transmission remaining above the selected threshold through 600 pulses and falling below it at the 800-pulse state. These dynamics realize the basis for a leaky integrate-and-fire photonic neuron, where the pulse-dependent ionic response provides integration, spontaneous relaxation supplies a passive leak, persistent states provide nonvolatile memory, and fixed-wavelength readout provides an optical threshold response.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates a ferroionic CuCrP2S6-on-silicon microring photonic platform that uses field-driven Cu-ion redistribution to produce history-dependent, partly volatile and partly nonvolatile resonance shifts enabling leaky integrate-and-fire neuromorphic photonic neurons via fixed-wavelength thresholded readout.
summaries.zh: 论文提出并验证了一种将层状CuCrP2S6通过后端集成工艺耦合到硅微环谐振器的铁电离子光子平台，利用电场驱动的Cu离子迁移产生具有历史依赖的谐振位移，该响应同时包含可挥发与非挥发成分，并通过固定波长阈值读出实现泄漏积分-发放的神经形态光子神经元。

title: Gradient Optical Diffraction Tomography Using Deep Learning-Assisted Amplitude Estimation
abstract: Gradient Optical Diffraction Tomography (GODT) enables the non-invasive reconstruction of a spatial derivative of the 3D sample's refractive index distribution, providing enhanced sensitivity to subtle refractive index variations through gradient-based contrast. Implemented using lateral shearing interferometry (LSI), GODT benefits from a common-path architecture that provides environmental stability and high signal-to-noise ratio measurements. Unlike conventional optical diffraction tomography (ODT), which requires numerical integration of LSI-derived phase gradients to recover the object phase, GODT enables direct tomographic reconstruction from the LSI data. Notably, GODT requires derivatives of both the phase and amplitude of the object fields as input. While the phase derivative can be readily extracted from LSI data, the amplitude gradient cannot be directly retrieved. Thus, in the original GODT formulation, the amplitude gradient was assumed to be negligible, limiting the accuracy of the resulting 3D reconstruction. In this work, we introduce amplitude-informed GODT (AI-GODT), which employs physics-informed supervised deep learning to estimate the missing amplitude gradient based on accessible LSI data, specifically the fringe modulation. The proposed approach, applying a ResNet architecture and training on computer-generated data, is validated through numerical simulation and experimental measurements of both a well-characterized test object and primary neuronal cell culture, demonstrating the network's ability to generalize to diverse samples. We show that incorporation of the recovered amplitude gradient into the GODT reconstruction pipeline improves the 3D reconstruction quality, especially in its out-of-focus regions. The software and datasets are openly available to facilitate reproducibility and further development.

summaries.en: The paper proposes amplitude-informed gradient optical diffraction tomography (AI-GODT), where physics-informed deep learning estimates the missing object amplitude gradients from lateral shearing interferometry data to enable direct, more accurate 3D refractive-index derivative reconstruction with improved quality—especially out of focus—validated by simulations and experiments and released with open code and datasets.
summaries.zh: 本文提出幅度知情的梯度光学衍射断层成像（AI-GODT），通过物理约束的深度学习从侧向剪切干涉测量数据中估计缺失的物体幅度梯度，从而实现无需数值积分的直接三维折射率分布导数重建，并在模拟与实验中验证其能显著提升重建质量（尤其在失焦区域），同时开源软件和数据集以促进复现与进一步研究。

title: Fourier-Transform Photothermal Spectroscopy with Transient-Lens Detection
abstract: We demonstrate Fourier-transform photothermal spectroscopy using broadband supercontinuum excitation and transient-lens detection. The output of a Ti:sapphire oscillator is broadened in a photonic crystal fiber to generate the supercontinuum pump, which is converted into a phase-stable pulse pair with a controllable femtosecond delay using a birefringent interferometer. The absorption-induced heating from the pump generates a transient thermal lens in the sample, which is detected as a function of delay by an off-resonant 800 nm photothermal probe beam. Fourier transform of the interferometric photothermal response yields a frequency-domain signal corresponding to the sample absorptance spectrum weighted by the pump spectrum. After division by the measured pump spectrum, the reconstructed photothermal spectrum is compared with a direct frequency-domain linear absorption measurement to evaluate the accuracy of the reconstruction. This method combines Fourier-transform broadband excitation with thermal-lens readout, allowing broadband linear absorption spectra to be obtained from pump-induced refractive-index changes rather than from transmitted excitation intensity. We demonstrate the method on phloxine B.

summaries.en: The paper presents a Fourier-transform photothermal spectroscopy method that uses a supercontinuum pump split into a femtosecond-delayed pulse pair and a transient-lens thermal readout probed off-resonantly to reconstruct broadband absorptance spectra in the frequency domain, validated against direct linear absorption measurements using phloxine B.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种傅里叶变换光热光谱方法：利用超连续谱泵产生可控飞秒延迟的相位稳定脉冲对，并用非共振探测光读取样品吸收引起的瞬态热透镜响应，通过对干涉光热信号做傅里叶变换在频域重建宽带吸收光谱，且以实验测得的线性吸收结果（以曙红B为例）评估了重建精度。

title: Unveiling gauge-invariant on-chip phases from light intensity
abstract: Physics-informed digital twins fitted to output powers increasingly program photonic processors, but these powers do not fix the implemented phase, which determines how light from different inputs interferes. Here we show that a twin trained on intensities alone predicts the gauge-invariant phase of programmed transformations, and that this prediction can be used to program the phase. On a $12\times12$ mesh, with phases measured by interference protocols formed by the mesh itself, intensity-only and phase-aware programs from random starts reach the same intensity fidelity but phase fidelities of 0.690 and 0.996, both as predicted by the twin. The prediction holds for blocks up to $10\times10$. With coherent inputs, the programmed phase determines the outputs: phase-aware programming reduces the direction-of-arrival error of an on-chip Butler matrix from 29 degrees to 2.0 degrees. Power measurements alone thus yield a phase-calibrated model of the mesh, without phase data in training or optics beyond the chip.

summaries.en: By training physics-informed digital twins only on measured output intensities, the paper shows they can accurately predict and then program the gauge-invariant on-chip phases of photonic transformations, enabling phase-sensitive operation on a 12×12 mesh with dramatically improved phase fidelity and steering accuracy even without phase data in training or optics beyond the chip.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，仅用输出光强训练的物理启发型数字孪生模型，能够预测并用于编程片上光子变换的规范不变相位；在12×12网格上其在随机起点下实现相位保真度显著提升（与孪生预测一致），并将片上Butler矩阵的到达方向误差从29°降至2.

title: Theory of Observability of Voigt-Wave Propagation in a Homogeneous Dielectric Material
abstract: A Voigt wave can propagate in a dissipative anisotropic dielectric material when a 4$\times$4 propagation matrix is defective, as happens for a uniform plane wave along a singular axis, and the field depends on the propagation distance linearly as well as exponentially. Whether it is observable outside a slab of that material generally depends on whether the defectiveness is inherited by the 2$\times$2 reflection and transmission matrices, which are extracted from the 2$\times$2 blocks of a 4$\times$4 transfer matrix that relates the fields at the two faces of the slab. Explicit tests exist for each type of defectiveness, and a counting argument shows that excitation and observability co-occur at oblique incidence only for isolated combinations of constitutive parameters and slab thickness. Normal incidence is exceptional: Voigt-wave excitation then generally implies a defective transmission matrix for almost all thicknesses, which explains Voigt's 1902 experiment on andalusite. Numerical searches for andalusite, $\beta$-gallium oxide, terbium orthoaluminate in a magnetostatic field, and hexagonal boron nitride show that a Voigt wave may be excited without being observable and that a defective reflection or transmission matrix need not signal the excitation of a Voigt wave.

summaries.en: The paper analyzes when a Voigt wave in a dissipative anisotropic dielectric—whose propagation is governed by a defective 4×4 propagation matrix—remains observable outside a slab by relating defectiveness in the 4×4 system to that inherited (or not) by the slab’s 2×2 reflection and transmission matrices, showing that excitation and observability coincide at oblique incidence only for isolated parameter/thickness combinations, while at normal incidence excitation generally forces a defective transmission matrix explaining Voigt’s 1902 experiment and numerical studies further demonstrate cases where Voigt waves can be excited without being observable and vice versa.
summaries.zh: 本文研究在耗散各向异性介质中当4×4传播矩阵出现缺陷时的Voigt波如何在穿出该介质薄片后是否可观测，并通过考察该缺陷是否会从4×4系统继承到薄片两侧场关系所用的2×2反射与透射矩阵来判定；结果表明在斜入射时仅当本构参数与薄片厚度的某些离散组合满足条件时激发与可观测性才会同时发生，而在法向入射时激发通常会导致缺陷透射矩阵，从而解释Voigt在1902年的实验，并且对安达卢石、β-氧化镓、特铒铝酸盐（含磁静场）以及六方氮化硼的数值搜索还显示：Voigt波可能被激发但不可观测，反之亦然，缺陷的反射或透射矩阵也不必然意味着Voigt波的激发。

title: Tunable Terahertz Bandpass Filter based on the Photonic Emulation of a 2DEG Interferometer through the Geometric Phase of Light
abstract: Terahertz frequencies are expected to become a key player in next-generation wireless communications. For this transition to occur seamlessly, tunable bandpass filters for channel selection are essential. However, conventional Fabry-Pérot cavity-based bandpass filters face inherent limitations. Specifically, their tunability is restricted by physical constraints, such as the maximum achievable mirror separation. In this work, drawing inspiration from electronic interferometers, we demonstrate a continuously tunable bandpass filter operating near 0.3 THz by exploiting the geometric phase of light, the Pancharatnam-Berry phase. Our device incorporates intracavity waveplates for polarization control and is described by a mathematical expression analogous to that of the electronic interferometer governed by the Aharonov-Bohm phase, thereby realizing a photonic analogue. Using custom-designed subwavelength waveplates and cavity mirrors, we achieve a finesse of $\mathcal{F}\approx17$, a quality factor of $Q\approx1.5\times10^{3}$, and a resonance linewidth of $\Delta f_{\mathrm{FWHM}}\approx 200$ MHz. Beyond terahertz communication technology, this system is expected to find applications in fields requiring high frequency resolution, such as spectroscopy.

title: Blind spatially varying PSF estimation for fluorescence microscopy
abstract: Optical aberrations degrade fluorescence microscopy images and measuring the underlying point spread function (PSF) often requires dedicated acquisitions or isolated emitters. Here we introduce DeepBlur, a neural network that estimates spatially varying two-dimensional PSFs directly from single images of biological structures. Trained entirely on physical simulations spanning aberrations, illumination and noise, it adapts to diverse imaging conditions without requiring user-supplied optical parameters. Using a deformable mirror, we acquire 1,290 images and assess blind PSF estimates against independent references. DeepBlur estimates agree closely with these references and improve deconvolution of experimentally aberrated images. Local PSF estimation also enables correction of spatially varying defocus and improves random-illumination super-resolution reconstruction in biological tissue. Available through DeepInv, a napari plugin and a web demonstration, DeepBlur can be readily integrated into computational microscopy workflows.
subjects: Optics (physics.optics) ; Computational Engineering, Finance, and Science (cs.CE); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

summaries.en: The paper presents DeepBlur, a neural network that blind-estimates spatially varying 2D PSFs from single fluorescence microscopy images using simulation-trained learning, achieving accurate PSF recovery and improved deconvolution and super-resolution by enabling local aberration correction.
summaries.zh: 本文提出DeepBlur，一种神经网络模型，可在无需额外采集的情况下从单张荧光显微图像盲估计空间变化的二维PSF，并基于仿真训练实现准确PSF恢复，从而通过局部像差校正提升去卷积和随机照明超分辨重建效果。

title: A Reconfigurable Four-State Sensor Based on Orthogonal Thermal and Chemical Stimuli
abstract: This article presents a novel four-state refractive index (RI) sensor based on distinct phases of palladium (Pd) and vanadium dioxide (VO$_2$), controlled by orthogonal thermal and chemical stimuli. This is a numerical, simulation-only study: all results are obtained from two-dimensional finite-element method (FEM) simulations. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first reported multi-state reconfigurable RI sensor tuned by external control. VO$_2$ serves as a phase change material (PCM) offering two thermally switchable phases with highly contrasting optical properties, while the hydrogen absorption property of Pd provides two additional phases. Combining these, four operational states are realized: (i) $\alpha$-Pd/low-$T$ VO$_2$; (ii) $\beta$-PdH$_x$/low-$T$ VO$_2$; (iii) $\alpha$-Pd/high-$T$ VO$_2$; and (iv) $\beta$-PdH$_x$/high-$T$ VO$_2$. Thermal crosstalk between Pd and VO$_2$ is mitigated through tungsten (W) doping of VO$_2$. This work further introduces conditional state sensitivity (CSS), a novel figure of merit quantifying the optical contrast between each state transition. The proposed sensor achieves a peak sensitivity of 2871 nm/RIU for the undoped reference configuration and 2798 nm/RIU for the practical W-doped device, together with a peak CSS of 16,872 nm/RIU, establishing it as a multi-state reconfigurable platform with reduced thermal crosstalk and potential applications in industrial safety monitoring and optical logic gates.

summaries.en: The paper numerically simulates a reconfigurable four-state refractive-index sensor that uses orthogonal thermal switching of VO2 and chemical hydrogen absorption by Pd to realize four combined material phases with reduced thermal crosstalk via W-doped VO2, introducing conditional state sensitivity (CSS) as a new metric and reporting high sensitivity (up to 2871 nm/RIU) and CSS (up to 16,872 nm/RIU) for potential safety monitoring and optical logic-gate applications.
summaries.zh: 该论文通过二维有限元数值模拟提出一种可重构四态折射率传感器：利用VO2的热致相变与Pd对氢的化学吸收形成正交控制，实现由两者组合出的四种材料相态，并通过向VO2掺入W来降低热串扰；同时提出“条件态灵敏度”(CSS)作为新指标，给出最高灵敏度（最高2871 nm/RIU）和最高CSS（最高16,872 nm/RIU），展望用于工业安全监测与光学逻辑门等应用。

title: Voltage-Enhanced Photorefractive Hysteresis in Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Photonic-Crystal Cavities
abstract: We observe voltage-enhanced photorefractive hysteresis in thin-film lithium niobate nanocavities, causing the resonance to appear at different wavelengths during increasing- and decreasing-wavelength laser scans. Their separation grows with bias magnitude and optical power, but depends weakly on scan speed over 1-200 nm/s. A quasi-static surface-trap model links voltage-biased carrier transport to asymmetric trapping, whose space-charge field shifts the resonance through the Pockels effect. The model captures this hysteresis across three cavities through switching between stable steady states. Space-charge feedback opposes further carrier separation, limiting the hysteresis gap. The model informs photorefractive mitigation and resonance control in integrated electro-optic devices.

summaries.en: The paper reports voltage-enhanced photorefractive hysteresis in thin-film lithium niobate photonic-crystal nanocavities, where Pockels-effect-driven resonance shifts differ for up- versus down-scans and are explained by a quasi-static surface-trap model with space-charge feedback that limits the hysteresis gap across multiple cavities.
summaries.zh: 论文观察到薄膜铌酸锂光子晶体纳腔中的电压增强型光折变滞后现象：激光扫描过程中共振波长在升扫与降扫时出现偏移且随偏置幅度和光功率增大而增大、对扫描速度（1–200 nm/s）依赖较弱，并通过准静态表面陷阱模型（载流子输运引起的空间电荷场经Pockels效应移频）并结合稳定稳态间切换来跨三个腔体解释，同时空间电荷反馈抑制进一步载流子分离、从而限制滞后间隙，为集成电光器件的光折变缓解与共振控制提供依据。

title: Pseudospin-mediated broadband hypersonic phonon transport beyond localized Berry curvature
abstract: Phononic nanostructures offer compact and highly confined control of elastic waves for signal transport, filtering, and quantum transduction. More recently, topological phononic structures have been explored as a route to robust waveguiding around defects and sharp bends, offering a promising basis for scalable and reliable phononic circuitry. However, how robust transport can persist as conventional localized Berry-curvature signatures diminish with increasing structural perturbation remains elusive. Here, we demonstrate bend-resilient hypersonic phonon transport beyond the conventional valley Hall framework. Using an engineered propeller phononic crystal operating at 1.9 GHz, we continuously increase the geometric perturbation to gradually weaken the valley topology while enhancing modal pseudospin character. Strikingly, as the Berry curvature progressively delocalizes from valleys, the complete elastic bandgap broadens to a normalized width of 34% and the interface modes become more strongly confined. Two-port electromechanical measurements on a thin-film lithium niobate-on-SOI platform experimentally confirm broadband interface-mode transport with no measurable bend-induced loss, despite the absence of well-localized valley-topology signatures. Our findings establish modal pseudospin engineering as a powerful design principle for robust acoustic guiding beyond conventional topological constraints, paving the way for broadband hypersonic phononic circuitry for classical and quantum information processing.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates bend-resilient broadband hypersonic phonon transport in a GHz propeller phononic crystal by engineering modal pseudospin such that transport remains robust even as localized valley Berry-curvature signatures diminish under increasing perturbations.

title: Optimization of a Locally Shielded 16-Channel Transmit Array for Human Brain MRI at 10.5 T via Electromagnetic/Circuit Co-Simulation and Parallel Transmission Strategies
abstract: Modern neuroimaging and neuroscience increasingly demand high spatial and temporal resolution, driving the use of ultrahigh-field (7 T and above) MRI for improved signal-to-noise ratio. Realizing this advantage depends critically on advanced radiofrequency (RF) and gradient technologies, particularly multi-channel transmit arrays and high-performance head-gradient systems. In integrated systems, a local RF shield must provide sufficient field confinement while preserving transmit performance and minimizing sensitivity to nearby conductive structures. In this work, we sought to optimize a locally shielded 16-channel transmit RF array for human neuroimaging at 10.5 T using electromagnetic/circuit co-simulation combined with parallel-transmission strategies. Candidate transmit-array and RF-shield configurations were evaluated before and after gradient-shield integration to identify a configuration with suitable RF transmit and shielding performance for the integrated system. The results show that no single standalone metric, including static RF shimming performance, dynamic parallel transmission (pTx) performance, or external-field leakage, reliably predicts robustness after gradient-shield integration. Progressive screening identified the aligned loop-folded dipole (LFD) array combined with a compact cylindrical shield featuring a conical top and three windows (160-mm radius and 70-mm window length) as the final configuration. Without RF-circuit retuning, the selected design maintained external-field leakage below 1% and after gradient shield integration achieved whole-brain excitation coefficient of variation (CoV) of approximately 27% with static RF shimming and 9% with dynamic pTx. Experimental validation of the unshielded LFD array showed good agreement between simulated and measured B1+ efficiency distributions, with a normalized root-mean-square error (NRMSE) of approximately 8%.

title: Diagnosing internal leakage currents through magnetometry of lithium-ion cells
abstract: Internal leakage currents are difficult to detect and to localize through measurements at the terminals of lithium-ion cells. We measured the magnetic fields of pouch cells non-invasively with a magnetometer while a battery cycler set the current and recorded the voltage. A three-axis magnetoresistive sensor remains fixed inside a three-layer magnetic shield, and two linear stages move the cell in two dimensions relative to the sensor to acquire a map of the magnetic field above the cell. The field of an intact cell was linear in current from 10 to 420 mA, and its maps were symmetric between charge and discharge. To create internal leakage currents, two 600 mAh cells were damaged by mechanical indentation. Both cells developed a magnetic field at zero applied current that decayed over hours, while the cell voltage showed a loss of charge by self-discharge. This field breaks the symmetry between the charge and discharge maps, which allows leakage to be detected while the cell is being cycled. At rest, the setup detects leakage currents down to about 1--3 mA. The results highlight opportunities for battery diagnostics and safety, and may help in designing techniques for characterizing soft shorts.

summaries.en: The paper proposes and demonstrates non-invasive magnetic field mapping of lithium-ion pouch cells using a fixed three-axis magnetoresistive sensor to detect and localize internal leakage currents created by mechanical damage, showing zero-current fields that decay and break charge/discharge symmetry and enabling detection at about 1–3 mA while cycling.
summaries.zh: 论文提出并验证了一种通过固定式三轴磁阻传感器对锂离子软包电芯进行非侵入磁场测绘的方法，用于检测由机械损伤引发的内部漏电流：受损电芯在零外加电流下会出现随时间衰减的磁场并打破充放电对称性，从而在循环过程中实现约1–3 mA量级的漏电检测，并为电池诊断与软短路表征提供参考。

title: Quditology: harnessing many levels for quantum information processing
abstract: Quantum computing offers the prospect of surpassing classical computation on certain tasks by leveraging quantum coherence and entanglement. However, a significant gap remains between current quantum hardware and the requirements to transcend what classical computers can achieve, with decoherence limiting the capacity of storing quantum information and the number of logical steps that can be executed reliably. In the long term, fault tolerance bridges this gap, but simply changing the numerical base from binary to higher base d is a viable way to 'squeeze more juice'---get more quantum information processing---from a quantum computer of given size. Additionally, for quantum simulations, qudits offer a natural encoding scheme for high-dimensional physical degrees of freedom. Here, we review recent experimental progress in high-fidelity preparation, control, and measurement of qudits across various platforms such as trapped ions, superconducting circuits, solid-state nuclear spins, photonic systems, and neutral atoms. We highlight early demonstrations of qudit-based quantum simulation, computation and error suppression enabled by these developments, heralding the transition of qudits from conceptual constructs to viable building blocks for quantum technologies. Finally, we outline key challenges and potential future directions for scalable qudit quantum information processing.

summaries.en: The paper reviews how using qudits (quantum systems with d-level states) can increase quantum information capacity beyond binary hardware limits, both by mitigating decoherence and by providing natural encodings for simulations, summarizing experimental advances across multiple platforms and outlining remaining challenges for scalable qudit-based quantum computing and technology.
summaries.zh: 论文综述了利用“多能级量子位”（qudits）的意义：在给定硬件规模下通过从二进制扩展到更高维度来挤出更多可用的量子信息处理能力，并为量子仿真提供更自然的高维物理自由度编码，重点总结了在多种平台上的高保真制备、控制与测量进展，同时概述了实现可扩展qudit量子信息处理所面临的关键挑战与未来方向。

title: Gauge symmetry permits extremely low-depth random unitary circuits
abstract: Continuous global symmetries can obstruct logarithmic-depth symmetric unitary $k$-designs and pseudorandom unitaries (PRUs) through long-range correlations. We ask whether gauge symmetries impose analogous limitations. For $\mathrm{U}(1)$ lattice gauge theories, we identify a randomization scale $c$, the minimum patch size needed for matter to screen every allowed boundary-flux mismatch, and a diffusive scale governing boundary-flux correlations. Glued circuits built from gauge-symmetric unitaries with subdiffusive support are efficiently distinguishable from gauge-symmetric Haar-random unitaries, whereas local controlled designs can be glued into global approximate designs when overlaps exceed the diffusive scale multiplied by a logarithmic factor. Our analysis suggests incomplete screening limits design guarantees to constant order, whereas strictly locally random systems with complete local screening ($c=1$) admit a local tensor-product description, permitting superpolynomial design orders and logarithmic-depth designs and PRUs. We construct a toy model of charged black-hole evaporation in which insufficient screening makes uninterrupted complete discharge exponentially unlikely in $c$, whereas strict local randomization removes this screening obstruction. This motivates a quantum-information analogue of the weak gravity conjecture, requiring the available charged spectrum to support complete local screening in addition to superextremality. We conjecture that this condition allows gauge-symmetric systems to scramble as rapidly as unconstrained ones and support this by constructing logarithmic-depth approximate strong designs and strong PRUs.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; High Energy Physics - Theory (hep-th)

summaries.en: The paper shows that in U(1) lattice gauge theories gauge symmetry sets a screening/randomization scale and a diffusive boundary-flux correlation scale, determining whether gauge-symmetric random unitary circuits can be distinguished from or efficiently approximate gauge-symmetric Haar randomness, and it argues that only systems with complete local screening (c=1) can achieve logarithmic-depth designs/PRUs, illustrated via a toy charged black-hole evaporation model and a quantum-information analogue of the weak gravity conjecture.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，在U(1)晶格规范理论中规范对称性会设定一个屏蔽/随机化尺度以及一个边界通量的扩散相关尺度，从而决定由规范对称单元构成的随机幺正电路是会与规范对称的哈阿随机性可有效区分，还是能在重叠超过“扩散尺度×对数因子”时高效地近似它，并指出只有当能够完全局域屏蔽（c=1）时系统才可实现对数深度的设计/伪随机幺正；这些结论还通过带电黑洞蒸发的玩具模型与弱引力猜想的量子信息类比加以阐明。

title: Nitrogen-Vacancy Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy of $^{15}$N Spins in Potassium Nitrite Solution
abstract: Nitrogen is essential in agricultural fertilizers, yet its nanoscale interfacial dynamics remain largely unexplored. Although quadrupolar broadening complicates $^{14}$N nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) detection, $^{15}$N (I=1/2) provides well-defined nuclear-spin signatures but remains challenging to detect at the nanoscale due to its low natural abundance and small gyromagnetic ratio. Here, we use a microfluidic quantum sensing platform based on shallow nitrogen vacancy (NV) centers in diamond to detect $^{15}$N NMR from KNO$_{3}$ solution at room temperature and in a low magnetic field regime. Within femtoliter-scale sensing volumes, we measure a magnetic-field variance of up to ~442 nT$^{2}$, ~43 times greater than the expected statistical polarization. The $^{15}$N spin correlation decays within ~500 $\mu\mathrm{s}$, mainly limited by the NV spin lattice relaxation time and not by the molecular diffusion of the KNO$_{3}$ molecules. This is consistent with the formation of a KNO$_{3}$ adsorption layer on the diamond surface, supported by surface characterization.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall)

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates room-temperature, low-field nanoscale detection of the ^15N NMR signal from potassium nitrite solution using shallow NV-center microfluidic quantum sensors, achieving field variance far above statistical polarization and a ^15N spin-correlation decay of ~500 μs attributed primarily to NV relaxation and consistent with formation of a KNO3 adsorption layer on the diamond surface.
summaries.zh: 论文利用浅层NV中心的微流体量子传感平台在室温低磁场下成功检测来自KNO3溶液中^15N的NMR信号，在费升级探测体积内测得的磁场方差显著高于统计极化，并观察到^15N自旋关联在约500 μs内衰减，主要受NV自旋晶格弛豫限制而非KNO3分子的扩散，且与二氧化碳表面形成KNO3吸附层的结果一致。

title: A Realistic End-to-End Runtime Crossover Estimation for Quantum-Enhanced Training of Large-Scale Machine Learning Models
abstract: Machine Learning (ML) is one promising application domain for Quantum Computing (QC) speedups, but asymptotic complexity considerations often mask the actual engineering costs of actual end-to-end workflows. For the use case of training a linearized Neural Network with a Quantum Linear Solver, a provably favorable quantum scaling has been suggested. We present realistic resource estimates for this problem, accounting for data access, computation, and readout. Our analysis examines three increasingly complex benchmarking scenarios, under distinct sparsity-scaling assumptions, thereby enabling progressively more realistic resource estimates. We identify crossover regimes relative to classical methods and find that crossover points emerge only for very large problem sizes, long computation times, and highly restrictive output requirements. This work provides a blueprint for evaluating quantum-enhanced ML algorithms under realistic hardware constraints and help identifying the bottlenecks that must be overcome to approach industrial quantum utility.

summaries.en: The paper provides realistic end-to-end resource estimates for quantum-enhanced training of large linearized neural networks using a quantum linear solver, analyzes three benchmarking scenarios with different sparsity assumptions, and finds quantum-classical crossover only for very large problem sizes, long runtimes, and stringent output requirements under hardware-aware constraints.
summaries.zh: 论文针对使用量子线性求解器训练大型线性化神经网络，给出了考虑数据访问、计算与读出的一体化现实资源估算，并在不同稀疏性假设下分析三种基准场景，结果表明只有在问题规模极大、计算时间很长且对输出要求极苛刻时才可能出现量子-经典的交叉优势，从而为在硬件约束下评估量子增强机器学习并定位需要突破的瓶颈提供了蓝图。

title: Infrared-absorption magnetometry in a diamond nanocavity: demonstration and limits at the nanoscale
abstract: Diamond quantum sensors promise both high spatial resolution and high sensitivity; however, conventional photoluminescence-based spin readout can be difficult to integrate efficiently. Infrared absorption by nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centres in diamond provides a promising alternative, although the sensitivity of compact absorption-based sensors is limited by the short optical interaction length between the probe field and the NV ensemble. To overcome this limitation, we demonstrate, for the first time, singlet-absorption magnetometry using spin-dense diamond nanocavities. By probing cavity modes near the 1042 nm NV singlet transition, we observe spin-dependent cavity transmission and perform cavity-enhanced magnetic field sensing. We further develop and experimentally validate a model that accurately predicts the spin-dependent cavity response, describes the optimal operating conditions, and identifies the practical limitations of different optically detected magnetic resonance modalities. Together, these results establish cavity-enhanced singlet absorption as a scalable readout mechanism for integrated diamond quantum sensors and provide a practical framework for engineering next-generation nanophotonic diamond quantum magnetometers.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Applied Physics (physics.app-ph); Optics (physics.optics)

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates cavity-enhanced singlet-absorption magnetometry in spin-dense diamond nanocavities by probing the 1042 nm NV singlet transition, modeling the resulting spin-dependent cavity transmission to optimize operation and quantify limits of different optically detected magnetic resonance readout modalities for scalable nanoscale diamond quantum magnetometers.
summaries.zh: 论文通过在自旋密集的金刚石纳米腔中、探测1042 nm NV 自旋态（singlet）跃迁来实现腔增强的singlet吸收磁测量，观测并用模型准确预测自旋相关的腔透射响应以优化工作条件，并评估不同光学探测磁共振读出方式在纳米尺度上的实际限制，从而为可扩展的集成金刚石量子磁强计提供工程框架。

title: A scalable dense silicon qubit architecture with logical operations
abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) requires a large number of physical qubits to encode logical qubits with sufficiently low error rates. Silicon spin qubits are a promising platform because of their small footprint, compatibility with semiconductor manufacturing technologies, and demonstrated high-fidelity operations. However, realizing a scalable architecture that supports quantum error correction, qubit transport, wiring, and logical gate operations remains a major challenge. Here, we propose a scalable dense silicon spin qubit architecture designed to support large-scale FTQC. The architecture consists of qubit memories, data qubit lanes, and cross junctions. Qubit memories store logical qubits encoded using the rotated surface code and support logical single-qubit operations. Data qubit lanes enable high-speed one-dimensional spin shuttling for connectivity between logical qubits, while cross junctions provide routing functionality and implement transversal logical CNOT gates. Using experimentally demonstrated silicon spin qubit parameters, we evaluate logical error rates as a function of code distance and estimate that a code distance of at least 21 is required to achieve logical error rates below $10^{-10}$ per syndrome cycle. We further analyze wiring constraints based on CMOS-compatible multiplexed control schemes and show that, with optimized wiring efficiency, more than 120,000 logical qubits could be integrated on a 100 mm $\times$ 100 mm chip. These results provide a practical roadmap toward large-scale FTQC based on silicon spin qubit technology.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Applied Physics (physics.app-ph)

summaries.en: The paper proposes a scalable dense silicon spin-qubit architecture using rotated-surface-code logical qubit memories, high-speed 1D spin-shuttling data lanes, and cross-junction routing with transversal logical CNOTs, estimating that a code distance of at least 21 is needed for <10^-10 logical error rates per syndrome cycle and that optimized CMOS-compatible multiplexed wiring could support over 120,000 logical qubits on a 100 mm × 100 mm chip.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种可扩展的致密硅自旋量子比特架构：利用旋转表面码编码的逻辑量子比特存储器、用于互连的高速一维自旋穿梭数据通道，以及提供路由并实现纵向（transversal）逻辑CNOT门的交叉结；基于已实验验证的参数估算，需至少21的码距离才能使每次综合循环的逻辑误差率低于10^-10，并在优化CMOS兼容的复用控制布线效率后，理论上可在100 mm×100 mm芯片上集成超过12万逻辑量子比特，从而为硅自旋量子技术的大规模容错量子计算提供可行路线图。

title: High-Dimensional Single-Photon Frequency Conversion for Orbital Angular Momentum Comb State
abstract: The orbital angular momentum (OAM) degree of freedom provides an important resource for constructing high-dimensional optical quantum information systems. However, the generation of high-dimensional single-photon OAM comb state and its high-fidelity frequency conversion remain challenging due to limited spatial modulation resolution, imperfect mode matching, and finite nonlinear conversion efficiency. Here, we proposed and experimentally demonstrated a scalable scheme for the generation and frequency conversion of high-dimensional single-photon OAM comb state. We prepared a single-photon OAM comb state with a dimension of up to 128, achieving a fidelity of 0.787 between the reconstructed and target states and an effective dimension of 100. Furthermore, using the sum-frequency generation, we demonstrated the frequency upconversion of single-photon high-dimensional OAM comb state from the communication band to a visible wavelength of 520 nm, while verifying the preservation of both the OAM mode distribution and phase information through density matrix reconstruction. Our work established a versatile platform for the generation, manipulation, and characterization of high-dimensional OAM comb states, with potential applications in cross-band quantum information transfer, high-capacity quantum communication, and high-dimensional quantum networks.

summaries.en: The paper proposes and experimentally demonstrates a scalable method to generate a high-dimensional (up to 128) single-photon OAM comb state and to perform high-fidelity sum-frequency-based frequency upconversion to 520 nm while preserving OAM mode distribution and phase information via density-matrix reconstruction.
summaries.zh: 论文提出并实验验证了一种可扩展方案，可生成高维（最高128维）单光子OAM梳态，并利用和频产生将其上转换至520 nm，同时通过密度矩阵重建验证OAM模态分布与相位信息得以保留。

title: QPAT: A Universal Quantum Machine Learning Framework for Quantum-Assisted Training and Classical Inference
abstract: Deep learning models often struggle with sharp local optima and overfitting in limited-data regimes, and exhibit limited capacity for capturing high-order, complex probability distributions. Quantum Machine Learning (QML) models, by operating in exponentially large Hilbert spaces, can efficiently represent such distributions and provide favorable inductive biases for learning, offering a promising pathway to overcome these limitations. However, their practical deployment in the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era is severely hindered by gradient coupling, barren plateaus, data-loading bottlenecks, and high inference latency. To bridge classical AI and QML, we propose QPAT (QCBM-Prior-Assisted Training), a universal framework that employs a Quantum Circuit Born Machine (QCBM) as a learnable generative prior to provide a task-aligned structured inductive bias during classical model training. The framework can be seamlessly integrated into any classical backbone, including LSTMs, CNNs, and Transformers. We introduce a decoupled fitness-based scoring mechanism and a stochastic "Drop-Prior" mechanism to implicitly distill quantum structural knowledge into the classical weights during training. Evaluated extensively on six benchmarks spanning time-series forecasting, computer vision, and natural language processing, our framework consistently outperforms purely classical backbones in both predictive performance and stability across random seeds; ablation studies further show that these gains are not reproduced by unstructured random priors or a classically learned generative prior. Remarkably, our approach enables completely classical inference, bypassing quantum latency while preserving quantum-enhanced accuracy, paving a highly practical path for QML deployment.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

summaries.en: The paper proposes QPAT, a universal framework that uses a QCBM learnable generative prior to provide quantum-aligned inductive bias for classical model training via decoupled scoring and Drop-Prior distillation, improving stability and accuracy over six benchmarks while enabling fully classical inference without quantum latency.
summaries.zh: 本文提出QPAT通用框架，通过可学习的QCBM生成先验在经典模型训练中提供量子对齐的归纳偏置，并结合解耦的适应度评分与Drop-Prior蒸馏机制，在六个基准任务上相较纯经典骨干获得更稳定且更好的预测性能，且实现完全经典推理、绕过量子延迟，同时保留量子增强精度。

title: A bright source of high-dimensional spatially entangled photon pairs based on beam-like Type-II SPDC
abstract: Bright sources of high-dimensional spatially entangled photon pairs are increasingly required for the rapid advancement of quantum technologies. However, simultaneously achieving high brightness and high-dimensional spatial entanglement through spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate a bright source of high-dimensional spatially entangled photon pairs using beam-like Type-II SPDC in a $\beta$-barium borate crystal. Compared with a conventional collinear Type-I source, it exhibits a $\sim$1.56-fold enhancement in the detected single-photon count rate and a $\sim$1.45-fold enhancement in the coincidence count rate. Measurements of position correlations and momentum anti-correlations certify at least 62-dimensional spatial entanglement within a 121-dimensional basis. These correlations are further exploited to demonstrate quantum imaging in both the position and momentum domains. These characteristics make the source a practical resource for high-dimensional photonic quantum technologies.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates a bright beam-like Type-II SPDC photon-pair source in a β-barium borate crystal that delivers enhanced single and coincidence count rates and certifies at least 62-dimensional spatial entanglement (within a 121-dimensional basis), enabling quantum imaging in both position and momentum domains for high-dimensional photonic quantum technologies.
summaries.zh: 论文展示了一种基于β-钡硼酸盐晶体的束状Type-II SPDC高亮纠缠光子对源，该源在单光子与符合计数率上相较传统共线Type-I实现约1.

title: Reproducible distributions of energy-relaxation times in superconducting qubits from broadband SWAP spectroscopy
abstract: The distribution of the qubit energy-relaxation time (T1) in a superconducting quantum processor affects its logical error rates. However, reports on qubit fabrication quality focus on the median or best-case T1 from measurements that are not reproducible due to resonant coupling to two-level system (TLS) defects whose frequencies fluctuate in time. Here, we sweep the frequency f01 of a flux-tunable qubit over several GHz with SWAP spectroscopy, quoting the quality factor Q = 2 pi f01 T1 to make T1 comparable across frequencies. We show that the cumulative distribution of Q pooled over the sweep is reproducible across four thermal cycles spanning 326 days, up to the reshuffling of strongly coupled TLSs. In contrast to repeated measurements at a single frequency, the medians of the broadband Q distributions spread by an order of magnitude less over 3 days. The distance between the cumulative distributions of repeats comes close to its sampling floor only for the broadband sweeps. The broadband Q distribution further resolves small coherence differences between identically designed qubits on two dies of the same wafer. These results establish the broadband Q distribution as a reproducible metric for qubit fabrication quality.

summaries.en: The paper introduces broadband SWAP spectroscopy that measures a normalized quality factor Q=2πf01T1 across swept qubit frequencies, showing that the resulting cumulative Q distributions are reproducibly consistent over months and thermal cycles despite fluctuating two-level-system defects, with finer sensitivity to fabrication quality than single-frequency T1 measurements.
summaries.zh: 本文提出利用宽带SWAP光谱在扫频测量中归一化得到品质因子Q=2πf01T1，并表明尽管两能级缺陷的频率会随时间波动，宽带Q的累积分布在跨越数月的多次热循环中仍具有可重复的一致性，相比单频T1测量对器件制造质量的分辨更为敏感。

title: How Many Autonomous Encoded Qubits Force an Isotropic Noise Response?
abstract: Depolarizing noise scales trace distances by a common factor. An encoded qubit is autonomous if its reduced input state determines its output. For $D=2^n\ge4$, autonomy forces this isotropy at a sharp threshold of $(D^2+5)/3$ generic encodings, two more than state tomography requires. For Pauli noise, one generic encoding suffices. With one-bit readouts and no quantum memory or reference, switching encodings cuts the worst-case cost for the Pauli test by a factor of $D$, up to logarithms. For any family, a channel with leakage $O(D^{-3/2})$ can transmit one bit perfectly and erase another.

summaries.en: The paper shows that for autonomous encoded qubits under depolarizing-type noise, isotropy of the noise response is enforced at a precise threshold of (D^2+5)/3 generic encodings (for D=2^n≥4), while for Pauli noise only one generic encoding is needed and, with one-bit readouts, switching encodings reduces worst-case Pauli-test cost by a factor of D (up to logarithms), with an additional result that leakage O(D^{-3/2}) can transmit one perfect bit while erasing another.
summaries.zh: 论文证明：对满足“自治”条件的编码量子比特在退极化噪声下，噪声响应的各向同性会在 D=2^n≥4 时于 (D^2+5)/3 个通用编码的精确阈值处被强制；而对 Pauli 噪声仅需 1 个通用编码，并且在只有 1 比特读出且无量子记忆或参考的情况下，通过切换编码可使 Pauli 检验的最坏情况代价降低约 D 倍（除去对数项），同时给出结果：泄漏为 O(D^{-3/2}) 的信道能完美传输 1 比特并擦除另 1 比特。

title: Phonon-Aware Electron-to-Nuclear Spin Quantum Memory in NV Centers
abstract: Nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond are a promising solid-state platform for quantum memory: the electron spin can be optically initialized and read out, while nearby nuclear spins have long coherence times and can serve as storage qubits. In this work, we develop a phonon-aware open quantum system model for electron-to-nuclear spin state transfer in a single NV center. The model includes the NV electron spin, a coupled 13C nuclear spin, the hyperfine interaction, an effective microwave/radio-frequency-assisted SWAP interaction for writing and reading, a single effective phonon mode with longitudinal spin-phonon coupling, and Lindblad relaxation and dephasing channels. The dynamics are simulated with the Lindblad master equation in QuTiP, using the secular approximation and a hyperfine-resonant drive in the rotating frame. Without spin-phonon coupling and electron decoherence, the write-store-read protocol recovers the stored state with a fidelity above 0.9999. With the default decoherence rates, increasing the spin-phonon coupling from 0 to 0.06 MHz lowers the worst-case retrieval fidelity from 0.9994 to 0.9884, and the fidelity oscillates with the phonon-mode period because electron-phonon entanglement generated during the write step is partially undone during the read step. With a phenomenological temperature-dependent rate model, the fidelity decreases monotonically from 0.9997 at 1 K to 0.9938 at 300 K, while storage-time losses follow the assumed nuclear-spin decoherence rates. The storage-time plots, temperature sweep, and parameter maps identify operating regimes for NV-center quantum memory, and the accompanying open-source code provides a reproducible framework for studying phonon-limited quantum memory.

summaries.en: The paper develops a phonon-aware Lindblad open-system model for transferring quantum states between the electron and a coupled 13C nuclear spin in a single NV center, showing that ideal conditions yield >0.
summaries.zh: 本文建立了一个考虑声子影响的Lindblad开放量子系统模型，用于在单个NV中心中实现电子自旋与耦合的13C核自旋之间的量子态转移，结果表明理想情况下写入-存储-读出保真度可高于0.

title: Empirical De-Quantization and Norm-Controlled Spectral Audit of Quantum Cognition Machine Learning in an Emerging Equity Market
abstract: Quantum-inspired machine learning in econophysics describes states of financial markets through matrix Hamiltonians, using ground-state expectations to predict returns and spectral gaps to identify crises. Although early work reports encouraging advances, it remains unclear whether these stem from genuine noncommutative quantum geometry or from conventional classical regularization and scale effects. We test this in a controlled audit of matrix-form Quantum Cognition Machine Learning (QCML) and variational quantum circuits on the Moscow Exchange (2020-2025), combining daily equity data with causally lagged macro news under realistic trading costs, short-selling bans, and abrupt shifts in market regimes. By using capacity-matched operator swaps -- which progressively eliminate complex Berry phases and matrix noncommutativity down to a commuting classical Gibbs radial-basis limit under scale-invariant regularization -- as well as testing spectral indicators against radial-norm null hypotheses and untrained GUE random matrices, we isolate the contribution of each quantum element. In out-of-sample data, neither complex phases, noncommutativity, nor circuit entanglement improves the ranking of returns relative to classical controls. Once feature magnitudes are normalized, apparent crisis detection from raw spectral gaps drops below chance levels. These results show that on noisy equity panels, matrix-form QCML acts as an adaptive spectrally bounded classical smoothing kernel: it reliably integrates lagged news and curbs extreme crisis forecasts without passing economic multiple-testing thresholds, while our audit provides operator-swap and random-matrix controls for evaluating future quantum-inspired financial models.

summaries.en: The study performs a controlled “empirical de-quantization” audit of quantum-cognition matrix-form ML and variational quantum circuits on Moscow Exchange data, using operator-swap and spectral null controls to show that complex phases, noncommutativity, entanglement, and raw spectral-gap crisis signals provide no out-of-sample return-ranking or crisis-detection advantage over classical smoothing once normalization and trading-realism constraints are applied.
summaries.zh: 该研究在明斯克交易所数据上对量子认知的矩阵形式机器学习与变分量子电路进行受控“经验去量子化”审计，通过算符交换与谱指标的零假设对照，发现在线外样本中在加入真实交易约束并进行特征归一化后，复杂相位、非对易性、纠缠以及原始谱隙危机信号都无法相较于经典平滑方法提升收益排序或危机检测效果。

title: Real-Time Cryo-CMOS Photon-Number Readout from a Single SNSPD
abstract: Measurements leveraging the intrinsic photon-number resolution of Superconducting Nanostrip Single-Photon Detectors (SNSPDs) have recently gained traction due to the simplicity of the detector design. Intrinsic photon-number measurement schemes using SNSPDs encode the photon-number information in picosecond signal timing; these systems thus require high bandwidth readout and sensitive electrical measurement equipment. We show a cryogenic electronic circuit operating close to the SNSPD in the cryostat, which can isolate single-photon detection events directly from the SNSPD signal. This reduces the latency of the photon-number readout to (13.9 $\pm$ 0.3) ns, which enables feedforward operations based on intrinsic photon-number measurements with low latency.
