title: Coefficient-Range Mitigation on an 8-Bit Coherent Ising Machine
abstract: Mapping optimization problems to the restricted coefficient range of an 8-bit CIM can distort their encoded energy landscapes. We investigate whether three coefficient-range mitigation techniques previously studied for quantum annealing---interaction extension, bounded-coefficient encoding, and augmented Lagrangian penalties---improve end-to-end optimization outcomes. Experiments on weighted Max-Cut, multidimensional knapsack, and quadratic assignment show that the benefits are selective. At a fixed number of CIM calls, intermediate interaction extension yields higher mean best Max-Cut objectives, whereas aggressive extension degrades performance. Bounded-coefficient encoding improves the mean best feasible profit on one knapsack instance but not the other. Augmented Lagrangian perturbations increase feasibility when unshifted constraint penalties are too weak, but do not outperform the best unshifted penalty setting. Overall, coefficient-range mitigation is most effective when its strength is tuned to the problem and encoding, with aggressive mitigation potentially offsetting its benefits.

summaries.en: The paper tests three quantum-annealing-inspired coefficient-range mitigation methods for an 8-bit coherent Ising machine and finds their benefits are problem-dependent, with moderately tuned interaction extension improving some Max-Cut outcomes, bounded-coefficient encoding helping only one knapsack case, and augmented Lagrangian penalties improving feasibility only when penalties are initially too weak but not beating the best baseline.
summaries.zh: 论文在8位相干伊辛机上检验了三种受量子退火启发的系数取值范围缓解方法，发现其效果高度依赖具体问题：中等强度的相互作用扩展能提升部分最大割结果，界限系数编码只对一个背包实例有效，而增广拉格朗日扰动在初始约束惩罚过弱时能提高可行性但无法优于最佳的未缓解惩罚设置。

title: Ancilla-Assisted Accelerated Readout of Transmon Qubits
abstract: We present a scheme for accelerating dispersive readout of superconducting transmon qubits. Dispersive readout works by weakly coupling the target transmon to a resonator, such that the resonator experiences a state-dependent frequency shift, which can then be read out. Our scheme introduces an ancillary transmon coupled to the same resonator. By appropriately correlating its state with that of the target transmon (using a fast CNOT gate), we show that the resonator frequency shift is approximately doubled, halving the required measurement duration to maintain the same quality. We present analytical results within the dispersive approximation, before employing and extending the recently introduced technique of branch analysis to account for ionization and other nonlinearities. Using this, and taking into account realistic noise and gate times, we show that our scheme allows measurement durations smaller by a factor of approximately 0.6, demonstrating that it offers a viable route for accelerating measurements of transmon qubits.

summaries.en: The paper proposes an ancilla-assisted protocol that uses a fast CNOT-correlated ancillary transmon to approximately double the dispersive resonator frequency shift for superconducting transmon qubits, thereby reducing required measurement time (accounting for nonlinearities and realistic noise) by about a factor of 0.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种利用快速CNOT将辅助跨模特征与目标跨模相关联的辅助比特读出方案：通过让辅助跨模与同一谐振器耦合并与目标跨模态建立关联，可使谐振器的色散频移近似加倍，从而在考虑色散近似、非线性（如电离）及真实噪声与门时间后，将维持相同读出质量所需的测量时长约降低0.

title: Cross-chip transfer in quantum photonic neural networks
abstract: Fabrication variability makes it difficult to reuse one set of trained parameters across a batch of quantum photonic chips without additional chip-specific optimization. We examine how device-specific compensation and task tolerance shape cross-chip performance. For squared operator loss, local analysis predicts that reducing own-chip error through compensation incurs an increase in expected loss on independent chips. We use Monte Carlo ensemble training (MC-ENS), informed by an available statistical model of fabrication-induced parameter errors. It optimizes one shared parameter set for each task or target at a given fabrication scale by averaging losses over simulated chip realizations resampled from this model. Numerical simulations of a quantum photonic neural network compare MC-ENS with single-chip training, sharpness-aware training and a covariance-informed variant. For CNOT synthesis and Ising dynamics, MC-ENS reduces mean conditional process infidelity and increases mean postselection probability on unseen chips. In classification, high accuracy can persist despite substantial changes in the optical transformation. The decision-margin analysis shows when fabrication-induced score shifts are likely to change predicted labels. The trained shared parameters can be reused without device-specific retraining on unseen chips drawn from the same fabrication distribution.

summaries.en: The paper proposes Monte Carlo ensemble training (MC-ENS) to find shared parameter sets for quantum photonic neural networks that account for fabrication variability, showing via simulations that it improves cross-chip performance for tasks like CNOT synthesis and Ising dynamics and clarifies how decision margins determine label stability on unseen chips.
summaries.zh: 本文提出蒙特卡洛集成训练（MC-ENS）以在量子光子神经网络中获得考虑制造变异的共享参数集，并通过仿真表明其在如CNOT综合与伊辛动力学等任务上提升了跨芯片性能，同时用决策余量分析解释了在同一制造分布下对未见芯片的标签稳定性条件。

title: Squeezing-preserving coherent control in Fourier-shaped optical lattices
abstract: Motional squeezed states of atoms in optical lattices are affected by the anharmonicity of the trapping potential. Unequal vibrational energy spacings cause dephasing among the occupied motional-state coherences, leading to distortion of the wavepacket and a reduction in squeezing. We show numerically that adding a weak second or third spatial harmonic to a one-dimensional lattice slows the initial decay of the squeezing. Squeezed states are prepared by one or two sudden changes of the lattice depth. For each harmonic and each preparation scheme, we choose the harmonic amplitude that keeps the evolved state closest, on average over 1 ms, to its evolution in a harmonic trap. We then compare the squeezing with that in a sinusoidal lattice with the same initial squeezing and trap frequency. In all four cases studied, the successive squeezing maxima initially decay more slowly in the shaped lattice. The improvement arises because the optimal harmonic nearly equalizes the two dominant vibrational level spacings over the region occupied by the squeezed wave packet, which canceling the quartic term of the potential alone does not achieve. Because the amplitude of the added harmonic is static and can be produced with existing Fourier-synthesis techniques, lattice shaping offers a simple way to preserve motional squeezing without additional time-dependent control.

summaries.en: The paper numerically shows that adding a weak second or third spatial harmonic to a Fourier-shaped optical lattice, together with preparing motional squeezed states via one or two sudden lattice-depth changes, slows the dephasing-induced decay of squeezing caused by trap anharmonicity by choosing harmonic amplitudes that best approximate a harmonic-trap evolution and nearly equalize key vibrational spacings across the squeezed wavepacket, without requiring time-dependent control.
summaries.zh: 论文通过数值结果表明，在光学晶格中加入微弱的二次或三次空间谐波并用一次或两次突然改变晶格深度来制备动量挤压态，可通过选择使状态最接近谐振势演化的谐波幅度、在挤压波包所覆盖的区域近似均衡主导振动态间隔来减缓由阱势非谐性引起的去相位从而导致的挤压衰减，并且这一改进无需时间依赖的额外控制，且可静态实现于现有傅里叶合成技术之中。

title: Native higher-order optimization with entropy quantum computing
abstract: Higher-order interactions are common in applied optimization: parity checks, radar-code sidelobes, portfolio skewness and kurtosis, and marketing-channel synergies all yield cubic or quartic objectives. Quantum annealers and most Ising machines accept only quadratic objectives, and gate-based quantum processors build every higher-order term from two-qubit gates. Entropy quantum computing, realized in the hybrid photonic-electronic Dirac-3S system, accepts polynomials of degree up to five with all-to-all coupling over binary, integer or simplex-constrained continuous variables. No user-supplied quadratization or circuit compilation is needed. We formulate four industrial use cases as six cubic and quartic instances, run them on Dirac-3S with 30 samples each, and score every sample against a certified optimum or a classical best-known value. We also estimate their cost on quantum annealers, superconducting grids and trapped-ion registers under standard mappings. For the two densest instances, a portfolio with about 80,000 terms and a budget allocation with 360,000 terms, the quadratized problems need embeddings far beyond current annealers, over $10^5$ physical qubits for the portfolio alone, and one phase-separation layer costs over $10^6$ two-qubit gates before optimization. Dirac-3S ran all six natively and returned feasible, distinct solutions. All samples of the binary instances are single-flip local minima. The best portfolio sample lies within 0.32% of the best-known value and the best budget sample 15% above it, but no sample reached its reference. Classical solvers reach the references within minutes at these sizes, and random starts followed by a local polish reach comparable or better values, so the advantage established here is one of expressibility and mapping cost, not of solution quality. Whether it extends to time to solution at larger sizes remains open.

summaries.en: The paper shows that entropy quantum computing on a hybrid photonic-electronic Dirac-3S system can natively optimize cubic and quartic (up to degree five) polynomial problems with all-to-all coupling and without quadratization or compilation, running six benchmark industrial instances where Dirac-3S finds feasible distinct solutions but whose best qualities are comparable to fast classical methods, suggesting the main benefit is expressibility and reduced mapping cost rather than superior solution quality or guaranteed scaling in time-to-solution.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，混合光电的 Dirac-3S 系统实现的熵量子计算可原生优化三次与四次（最高到五次）多项式目标函数，并支持二值/整数或单纯形约束的连续变量且无需二次化或电路编译，作者在六个工业基准算例中运行发现 Dirac-3S 能给出可行且彼此不同的解，但最佳解质量与快速经典求解具有可比性，说明主要优势在于表达能力与降低映射成本，而非显著优于的解质量或已证明的时间到解随规模提升的优势。

title: Noise threshold for learning with quantum memory
abstract: A quantum memory can reduce exponentially the number of experiments needed to learn a physical process, but real memories are noisy. Here we show that, for Pauli memory noise with eigenvalues $\lambda_X,\lambda_Y,\lambda_Z$, the advantage is governed by $\lambda_X^2+\lambda_Y^2+\lambda_Z^2$. We prove that no protocol with an entangled probe gains an exponential advantage when this sum is at most one, reduce the general case to the additivity of a Rényi-2 coherent information, and find coded memories that retain a growing advantage within 1% of this threshold. On a superconducting processor, nine simultaneously operated Bell pairs show an advantage that grows or shrinks exponentially with system size, reversing where a parameter-free model predicts. A three-qubit repetition code turns a shrinking advantage into a growing one with all processor and readout errors included, and under dephasing its memory performs better than Bell sampling in any memory frame on a perfect processor.

summaries.en: The paper determines that when a quantum memory suffers Pauli noise with eigenvalues λX, λY, and λZ, the feasibility of exponential learning advantage depends on λX^2+λY^2+λZ^2, proving no entangled-probe protocol can surpass exponential advantage if this sum is ≤1 while presenting error-coded memory schemes and superconducting-processor experiments where repetition codes can restore or reverse the scaling relative to Bell sampling.
summaries.zh: 论文表明在量子记忆遭受Pauli噪声、特征值为λX、λY和λZ时，指数级学习优势是否可实现由λX^2+λY^2+λZ^2决定，并证明当该和≤1时任何带纠缠探针的方案都无法获得指数优势；同时提出能保留接近阈值优势的编码记忆方案，并在超导处理器上用重复码等实现实验，结果显示优势随系统规模可被恢复或反转，相比贝尔采样在含处理器与读出误差条件下表现更优。

title: Why do single photons produce interference fringes? The phase of a mode and the phase of a state
abstract: If the phase of a photon-number state is completely undetermined, how can single photons, sent one at a time through a two-slit apparatus, build up interference fringes? These lecture notes answer this question from first principles. Starting from Maxwell's equations, we expand the field in vector modes, quantize it, and introduce the quantity measured by a photodetector. We then show that the word ``phase'' refers to two different things: the phase of a mode, fixed by the optical setup, and the phase of the quantum state that excites the mode. Only the first determines the fringes. All calculations are given in full, and problems with solutions are included.

summaries.en: The paper shows from first principles that single-photon interference arises because the phase relevant to fringes is the fixed phase of the optical mode set by the experimental apparatus, not the undetermined phase of the photon-number quantum state.
summaries.zh: 本文从第一性原理证明：单光子也能形成干涉条纹是因为产生条纹所需的相位由实验装置固定的光学模相位决定，而不是由完全不确定的光子数量子态相位决定。

title: LatentRL-QAS: Transfer via Latent Reinforcement Learning for Quantum Architecture Search
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) emerges as a prominent approach to quantum architecture search (QAS), the automated design of quantum circuits. However, transferring what an agent has learned from one number of qubits to another is still weakly explored: the state, the action space and the neural network of a state-of-the-art RL-QAS agent all grow with the number of qubits, which makes transfer learning across qubit counts prohibitive. We make this transfer possible by introducing LatentRL-QAS, a latent space transfer and refresh framework for RL-based QAS. At its core, a circuit variational autoencoder encodes a circuit as one token per gate and maps circuits on any number of qubits into the same latent space. An RL agent navigates this space instead of adding gates, so its state, actions and network have the same size at every qubit count. The latent space is periodically refreshed with the agent's new discoveries and, for a larger system, grown from the solutions of the smaller one, so what is transferred is the representation of circuits, not network weights or past experience. To show transfer, we consider absolutely maximally entangled (AME) states, a resource for quantum error correction. LatentRL-QAS discovers the five- and six-qubit AME states without being shown them and prepares them in 89-99% of evaluation episodes, whereas the baseline RL-QAS fails to find them with the same budget, even with a network 10 to 17 times larger. LatentRL-QAS remains robust under depolarizing noise with single-qubit gate errors amplified 10x and two-qubit gate errors 5x compared with IBM quantum hardware. By decoupling the RL agent from the number of qubits, LatentRL-QAS lets quantum architecture search reuse circuit representations learned on smaller problems, providing a foundation for the transferable design of circuits across quantum optimization problems.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

summaries.en: LatentRL-QAS enables transferable quantum architecture search by using a circuit variational autoencoder to map quantum circuits of any qubit count into a shared latent space that an RL agent can navigate, allowing discovery of five- and six-qubit absolutely maximally entangled states with high success despite baseline failures and maintaining robustness under amplified depolarizing noise.
summaries.zh: LatentRL-QAS通过电路变分自编码器将任意量子比特数的量子电路映射到共享潜在空间，并让强化学习智能体在该空间中进行搜索，从而实现跨比特规模的可迁移量子架构搜索；实验表明它能以高成功率发现五与六比特的绝对最大纠缠态，而基线方法在相同预算下失败，并且在放大退相干噪声下仍保持鲁棒性。

title: Monotone Crossing Lattices for Exact Binary Optimization Encodings on Rydberg Arrays
abstract: Programmable Rydberg-atom arrays realize maximum-weight independent set encoding on unit-disk graphs under the ideal blockade model, but embedding nonlocal interactions requires auxiliary atoms and limits the size of tractable instances. We introduce a four-state unit-disk crossing cell that couples directly to adjacent cells, with interfaces enforcing one-sided propagation: along occupied paths directed away from the diagonal, copy bits are nondecreasing. For the maximum-weight independent set problem, uniform cell weights guarantee that every ground state of the encoded instance decodes to an optimal solution of the original problem, even when local copies disagree. For binary quadratic objectives subject to pairwise Boolean constraints, every feasible optimum yields consistent active copies and a target weight given by an explicit constant offset minus the source objective. A rectangular variant of the architecture further encodes minimum set cover problem. Prior to constraint-induced site deletions, the full layout requires $2n^2 - n$ sites, halving the leading-order site count of a fixed complete-grid reference, while activity pruning yields an exact site count set by the propagation span. Across 18 paired benchmarks with independent ordering from a shared candidate pool, the layout reduces site counts by 12.1%-54.0%.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Data Structures and Algorithms (cs.DS)

summaries.en: The paper proposes a four-state “monotone crossing cell” architecture for Rydberg-atom arrays that enables exact encodings of binary optimization problems—such as maximum-weight independent set and minimum set cover—using local, one-sided propagating bit copies with provable decoding correctness and reduced qubit/site counts, achieving 12.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种用于Rydberg原子阵列的四态“单调穿越单元”架构，通过局部、单向传播的比特拷贝并给出严格证明的解码正确性，实现对二值优化问题（如最大权独立集与最小集合覆盖）的精确编码，同时显著减少所需站点数，并在18个基准上实现12.

title: Exact monogamy of steering and remote Wigner negativity for multimode Gaussian nodes
abstract: Optical quantum networks route correlations through nodes that hold several modes and are linked to many neighbors. Steering is the correlation behind one-sided device-independent tasks and behind the remote preparation of non-Gaussian states. It is monogamous for a single mode, which can be steered by only one party, but how many neighbors can steer a node with $k$ modes was not known. We show that for Gaussian states the answer is exactly $2k-1$ when the neighbors use Gaussian measurements, with any number of measurement settings. The limit follows from a simple bound. To every neighbor we assign a share, computed from the covariance matrix, and we prove that the shares of all neighbors add up to at most $k$, irrespective of the amount of squeezing, amplification or noise the network contains. A neighbor steers the node by Gaussian measurements exactly when its share exceeds one half, and a network built from a harmonic tight frame reaches the limit. The same number governs remote Wigner negativity. A heralded non-Gaussian operation at the node can make at most $2k-1$ neighbors Wigner negative, and in our network a single heralded projection makes all of them negative in the same run. With $n$ settings of arbitrary measurements, at most $nk-1$ neighbors can steer the node or violate a Bell inequality with it. More than $2k-1$ neighbors can therefore steer the node or violate a Bell inequality with it only if they use non-Gaussian measurements with at least three settings, whereas entanglement can reach any number of neighbors. These results determine exactly how many neighbors one multimode node can serve with steering and with remote Wigner negativity.

summaries.en: The paper proves that for multimode Gaussian nodes in optical quantum networks, exactly 2k−1 neighboring parties can steer the node (and generate remote Wigner negativity) using any number of Gaussian measurement settings, with the bound determined by additive “shares” from the covariance matrix and tightness shown by harmonic tight-frame networks, while achieving greater neighbor numbers requires non-Gaussian measurements with at least three settings and Bell violations scale as nk−1.
summaries.zh: 该论文证明，在光量子网络中多模高斯节点的精确“单边性”关系：当邻居使用任意多个高斯测量设置时，恰好有 2k−1 个邻居能够通过高斯测量实现对节点的凝聚（steering）并触发远程 Wigner 负性，且由协方差矩阵中可加的“份额”给出上界并用谐谐紧框架网络实现饱和；若要让邻居数超过 2k−1，则必须至少用三种设置的非高斯测量，并且与 Bell 不等式的违反对应的上界为 nk−1。

title: Neural Network Decoders For Qubit Loss
abstract: Qubit loss is a significant source of error in many quantum hardware platforms, requiring circuits that periodically replace or reset qubits to maintain fault-tolerance. When the reset process includes loss-resolving measurements, this information can improve decoding and substantially reduce overhead compared to the case where this information is not available. Prior work has demonstrated loss-tolerant circuits for the surface code that show significantly improved thresholds and subthreshold scaling by incorporating loss information. However, the computational complexity of loss simulation and decoding, which falls outside of the usual stabilizer framework, has limited extending these studies to high-rate qLDPC codes, which are already challenging to decode in the absence of loss. In this work, we present a loss-aware convolutional neural-network (CNN) decoder framework that circumvents this challenge. Training is enabled by a novel sampler, \texttt{slim}, which achieves a throughput for circuits with Pauli noise and loss that is comparable to the state-of-the-art for pure Pauli noise. On the surface code with loss, the decoder matches the accuracy of computationally expensive most-likely error (MLE) decoders at much lower latency. For the $[[144,12,12]]$ bivariate bicycle (Gross) code, we study a walking syndrome extraction circuit with Pauli and loss errors. For physical error rates $p<1\%$, we observe a more than $10^3$-fold lower logical error rate for a pure loss model, relative to a pure Pauli error model at the same physical error rate, along with significantly enhanced sub-threshold error rate scaling. This demonstrates that loss-dominated error models can also significantly improve performance in a high-rate qLDPC code, and provides a simulation and decoder training platform that can be extended to other codes and algorithmic gadgets.

summaries.en: The paper introduces a loss-aware convolutional neural-network decoder trained with a new sampler (slim) to efficiently decode quantum error-correction circuits with qubit loss, achieving surface-code performance comparable to expensive MLE decoding at much lower latency and yielding over 10^3-fold logical error-rate improvements in a high-rate [[144,12,12]] qLDPC code under loss-dominated errors, with enhanced sub-threshold scaling.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种利用新采样器（slim）训练的、具备损失感知能力的卷积神经网络解码器，用于高效解码包含比特损失的量子纠错电路：在表面码上以更低延迟达到接近昂贵MLE解码的精度，并在高比率[[144,12,12]] qLDPC码的损失主导误差模型下观察到逻辑错误率相对纯Pauli模型在相同物理错误率下下降超过10^3倍，同时实现更优的次阈值标度。

title: Complementary mechanisms of critical quantum metrology
abstract: Critical metrology conventionally exploits enhanced susceptibility to a system parameter near a phase transition. Here we identify a complementary mechanism for critically enhanced estimation of intrinsic system parameters via suppressed quantum noise rather than enhanced response. We demonstrate both mechanisms in coherently radiating spin states (CRSS)-correlated states of $N$ spin-$1/2$ particles defined as asymptotic eigenstates of the collective-spin lowering operator with complex eigenvalue $r e^{-i\varphi}$. At the critical value $r=1$, CRSS exhibit a second-order transition. We show that near criticality, estimation of $r$ benefits from enhanced susceptibility despite increased noise, whereas estimation of $\varphi$ benefits from suppressed quantum noise without enhanced response. Remarkably, both yield the same estimation error $\sim N^{-2/3}$, improving over the standard quantum limit $N^{-1/2}$. For $\varphi$, this establishes quantum-enhanced metrology of phases intrinsic to the critical system, rather than phases externally encoded by interferometry. We demonstrate these results for CRSS realizations in both dissipative (superradiant) and Hamiltonian (Ising) systems relevant to cavity QED and trapped ions, where fast preparation of CRSS is shown possible thanks to gap opening. Applications to metrology of coupling rates and phases or optical lengths are discussed.

summaries.en: The paper shows that near a critical point, quantum metrology can be enhanced either by increased susceptibility to an intrinsic parameter or by suppressed quantum noise without enhanced response, using coherently radiating spin states that undergo a second-order transition at r=1 and achieving the same improved scaling of estimation error ~N^{-2/3} for both r and the intrinsic phase φ across dissipative and Hamiltonian realizations relevant to cavity QED and trapped ions.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，在临界附近量子测量的增强既可以来自对内禀参数的响应（灵敏度）增大，也可以来自量子噪声被抑制而响应不增强，作者以在 r=1 发生二阶跃迁的相干辐射自旋态为例，证明对参数 r 与内禀相位 φ 的估计误差都可实现相同的改进标度 ~N^{-2/3}，并在与腔 QED 和囚禁离子相关的耗散与哈密顿系统中验证。

title: Observation of a Förster Resonance in a Heated Rydberg Atom Ensemble
abstract: Rydberg atoms in thermal vapour are of increasing relevance for a range of emerging technologies including compact electric field sensors, where state energies are detected via electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT). However, at increased atomic number densities, the Rydberg EIT response becomes non-linear, resulting in distortion of the spectral lineshape. It is thought that this non-linearity mainly arises due to ionisation, although accurate quantitative modelling of the spectrum and assessment of other physical processes remains challenging. In this work, we address these issues in a combined theoretical and experimental study, constructing a model that accurately reproduces observed EIT spectral profiles. We show from analysis of lineshape shifts that while ionisation accounts for most of the non-linearity, it is also possible to observe Rydberg interaction effects for strongly-coupled states near a Förster resonance.

summaries.en: The paper presents a combined theoretical and experimental model for electromagnetically induced transparency in dense thermal-vapour Rydberg ensembles, showing that ionisation explains most non-linear spectral distortions while also revealing Förster-resonance-driven interaction effects near strongly coupled states.
summaries.zh: 本文通过理论与实验相结合的模型研究致密热原子气体中里德堡原子电磁感应透明（EIT）的非线性光谱畸变，表明电离解释了大部分非线性，同时在强耦合态附近还能观察到福斯特共振引起的里德堡相互作用效应。
